metric_definitions.delta: candidate objective minus current objective before acceptance
metric_definitions.stuck_events: starts of streaks without a new best; legacy metric
metric_definitions.stagnation_episodes: streaks reaching 100 iterations without a new best; counted once until a new best resets the streak; not proven local optima
metric_definitions.history_index_zero: initial state; no candidate or acceptance decision
metric_definitions.evaluation_bias: zero-only compatibility option; ShippingFee is unchanged
